cases.purpose: Compare the complete DNS query wire image after zeroing only its random transaction ID; retain the original raw packet and QNAME case. No EDNS additional record is sent.
cases.candidate_script: export BASHDNS_RESOLV_CONF="$PWD/resolv.conf" BASHDNS_0X20=0; dns query WwW.Example.test A 2>/dev/null
cases.oracle: BIND dig with explicit matching flags; independent RFC 1035 header/question encoding and RFC 6891 OPT encoding. BASHDNS_0X20=0 is the documented switch disabling query-case randomization for this deterministic comparison.
cases.comparison: Every request byte except the two transaction-ID bytes is compared; the unmodified packet remains in peer evidence. CLI DNSSEC warning policy is excluded from this wire-format check by explicit stderr redirection on both sides.

cases.purpose: Observe every socket syscall after a fresh shell announces command readiness, and require invalid nc requests to return usage status before any socket or DNS activity.
cases.oracle: The original nc usage contract requires status 2 before socket activity. An unprivileged seccomp notification supervisor records all socket families; a write to inherited descriptor 3 marks the end of shell startup. Trusted setup proves that a known post-marker socket is recorded.
cases.comparison: Exact status, empty nc stdout, and zero post-readiness socket calls for each invalid form. Startup libc/NSS activity is separated by an explicit marker. Complete per-form syscall logs remain in the result tree.
cases.setup_script:
/usr/bin/python3 /opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/system-seccomp.py --notify socket --notify write:0=3 --log-args write=0 --log-args socket=0 --log probe-trace -- /usr/bin/python3 -c 'import os,socket;os.write(3,b"START");socket.socket(socket.AF_INET,socket.SOCK_STREAM).close()' 3>probe-marker
[[ $(/usr/bin/python3 count-sockets.py probe-trace) == 1 ]]
rm -f probe-trace probe-marker

files.count-sockets.py:
import json,sys
rows=[json.loads(s) for s in open(sys.argv[1])]
markers=[i for i,r in enumerate(rows) if r["syscall"]=="write" and r.get("arg0")==3]
assert len(markers)==1,rows
print(sum(r["syscall"]=="socket" for r in rows[markers[0]+1:]))
